candidates.label: Bat for info, then attack, then Enduring Curiosity

response.why: Both my Sheoldred and Preacher have deathtouch, and their only real blockers are their own summoning-sick Sheoldred and a 1/1 Vampire Token - any block trade kills their Sheoldred while I likely keep at least one attacker, so attacking is very favorable; casting Deep-Cavern Bat first also reveals their hand to check for combat tricks before committing.
response.plan: Attack with both deathtouch creatures to force a favorable trade against their Sheoldred; develop with Deep-Cavern Bat (hand info) and Enduring Curiosity to keep pressuring their 15 life total.

request.turn_plan_note: this window was not covered by your turn_plan; answer it, and optionally return a revised "turn_plan"

response.why: Attacking trades my Sheoldred for theirs while dealing zero net damage (their Vampire Token chump-blocks Preacher for lifelink), a fair but unremarkable outcome; holding back and developing Bat + Enduring Curiosity keeps my full four-creature board (11 power) intact against their smaller board, setting up a much bigger attack next turn instead of an even trade now.
response.plan: Skip the attack this turn since it only trades bombs evenly with no net damage; instead develop Deep-Cavern Bat and Enduring Curiosity to build an overwhelming board for a bigger attack next turn once summoning sickness wears off.

candidates.label: Bat for info, then attack, then Enduring Curiosity

request.turn_plan_note: this window was not covered by your turn_plan; answer it, and optionally return a revised "turn_plan"

response.why: No block risks dropping to 9 life against their growing board; blocking their Sheoldred with Enduring Curiosity only chump-saves life without permanently removing a threat, while blocking their Preacher trades for a permanent kill of their recurring deathtouch attacker (and Enduring Curiosity returns as a card-drawing enchantment regardless of how it dies), landing at a safer 11 life with their board thinned.
response.plan: Block their Preacher of the Schism with Enduring Curiosity to permanently remove it (EC returns as an enchantment either way) while taking less overall damage than no-blocking; keep Sheoldred and my own Preacher for a big attack next turn.

response.why: Casting Floodpits Drowner on their Sheoldred taps it and stuns it, removing their best blocker before combat; with only their 1/1 Siren left to block, attacking with both Preachers, the Vampire Token, and my Siren (6 total power) against their 6 life puts them in serious danger even if they chump one attacker.
response.plan: Stun their Sheoldred with Floodpits Drowner to remove it as a blocker, then attack with everything to push them to critical life or possibly lethal.
